title: Robots
tagline: Lure the robots into each other. Stay out of reach.
teaser: Robots step toward you every turn: trick them into crashing into each other while a floodlit stadium among the stars roars louder with every pile-up. Play the original wave after wave, tour twelve matches up to fifty robots, race the clock in Blitz, or meet the same waves as everyone in the Daily Showdown.

manPage.synopsis: robots — move one step at a time and make the robots collide.
manPage.description: Ken Arnold’s turn-based chase, where your only tool is making the pursuers crash. Christos Zoulas later added an automatic mode.

howToPlay: Move one step at a time; every robot steps toward you.
Trick robots into crashing into each other and into the scrap: the louder the crowd, the more each crash is worth.
Teleport when cornered, meet the jumbotron's calls, and clear the board to win the wave.
